description: Seventeen-year-old Alexander Du has made waves with his creation, IRIS, an AI-powered wearable aimed at aiding the visually impaired. His remarkable efforts were acknowledged in a ceremony at the White House, as he aspires to expand IRIS's reach to countless individuals worldwide.

description: A 46-year-old man was found dead in a high-end vehicle on Sunday morning. Identified as Salim Akbar from Kodagu, he was discovered unresponsive. While authorities are awaiting further reports, they suspect health issues may have played a role in the death, with no indications of foul play.

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: For the first time ever, a self-flying airplane has flown 3,199 miles to complete a journey across the US. A single-engine Cessna Caravan, managed by aerospace firm Joby Aviation, completed the transcontinental voyage without a human pilot onboard, relying entirely on autonomous computing architecture to navigate every stage from runway taxiing to takeoffs and touchdowns. The robotic aircraft departed Joby’s base in Concord, California. The aircraft touched down at Alliance Airport in Fort Worth, Texas, alongside a stop at Shaw Air Force Base in South Carolina.

description: Ed Sheeran addressed the Macklemore controversy and the Israel-Palestine conflict during his Philadelphia concert. He acknowledged making mistakes and spoke about free speech and the humanitarian issue. His comments generated divided opinions among fans and social media users. Some defended his stance while others questioned his approach to the situation. Sheeran expressed his heartbreak over the devastation and loss of civilian lives.
title: Ed Sheeran's Macklemore controversy sparks mixed reactions

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Elavenil Valarivan narrowly missed gold in the women’s 10m air rifle final at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, settling for silver with 252.4 points. Japan’s Taichi Hinata won gold with 253.0, while South Korea’s Ban Hyojin took bronze. Elavenil had earlier helped India win team silver, adding a second medal to the country’s shooting haul.
title: Second medal for India, Elavenil wins silver in women’s 10m air rifle at Asiad 2026

author: MATEEN HAFEEZ
description: In a devastating early morning crash, a speeding BMW plunged off Mumbai's Coastal Road bridge. This unfortunate event occurred at a construction site, resulting from the driver's loss of control. Three lives were claimed in the accident, with Shanay Gajjal and Dhirya Seth identified among the deceased; the third passenger’s identity remains unknown. Meanwhile, one individual is critically injured, leading authorities to start a thorough investigation into the circumstances.
title: CCTV shows BMW crashing through barrier, falling off Mumbai Coastal Road bridge; 3 dead

author: AARAV DENGLA
description: In his latest Grandmaster View column, India’s young GM Aarav Dengla looks back at how the Bolsheviks transformed chess from a pastime of Russia’s aristocracy into an instrument of mass education, military training and cultural revolution. From Ilyin-Zhenevsky and the Red Army to Botvinnik, Tal, Karpov and Kasparov, Aarav traces how a century-old state-backed experiment helped build the Soviet chess machine, and a legacy that still shapes the chess world today.
title: Red Pawns, Red Soldiers: How the Bolsheviks built a chess superpower

author: TOI Education
description: Nila Vikhe Patil, from a prominent Indian political family, has been elected to Sweden's Parliament. She will represent the Green Party in the 349-seat Riksdag after years of dedicated party work. Patil's career includes roles in the Swedish Prime Minister's office and municipal governance. Her education in economics and law shaped her focus on finance and taxation portfolios.
title: Who is Nila Vikhe Patil, Maharashtra-origin leader elected to Sweden Parliament?

author: RAJEEV SINGH
description: Mentioning the Ranka's post, another CJP member Sourav Das quipped: "People of Rajasthan, tell us where you want us to come. Government is releasing and fixing places before our visit!" Last month, Ranka alleged that Rajasthan Police was keeping a watch on people entering and leaving his house, hours after the organisation’s team faced a confrontation during its campaign to inspect government schools.
title: 'Tell us where to come, schools fixed before our visit': CJP mocks Rajasthan govt

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Eve-teased at 12, Suchika Tariyal took up judo for self-defence, beginning a journey through judo, Ju-Jitsu and MMA. At 36, the Rohtak fighter became India’s first Asian Games MMA medallist after beating Mongolia’s Altanchimeg Baigalmaa 2-0 to reach the -60kg semifinals. A former eight-time national judo champion, Tariyal now hopes her journey inspires more young women.
title: At 12, she was eve-teased: Suchika is now India’s first Asian Games MMA medallist

author: HADI KHAN
description: Three people died and one was critically injured after a BMW crashed on the Mumbai Coastal Road. The incident occurred early Sunday morning due to alleged overspeeding by the driver. Two deceased victims were identified as Shanay Gajjal and Dhirya Seth. An unidentified 25-year-old man also died, and a 20-year-old remains in critical condition. The car was traveling from Marine Drive towards Haji Ali when the accident happened.
title: 3 youths killed, 1 critical after speeding BMW crashes on Mumbai's Coastal Road

description: Suchika Tariyal secured India's first medal at the Asian Games on Sunday. She defeated Mongolia's Altanchimeg Baigalmaa in the women's Traditional Mixed Martial Arts 60kg quarterfinal. Tariyal's progression into the semifinals guarantees India a medal in MMA's debut. She previously represented India in judo and kurash and became a Jiu-Jitsu world champion. Her journey includes overcoming challenges and a knee injury to reach this achievement.
title: Suchika Tariyal scripts history, assures India of first Asian Games medal

Both Elavenil and Sonam made it to the final of the individual 10m air rifle competition. Building on their previous success in Hangzhou, the team is eager for more medal opportunities in the upcoming events.

author: VIJAYA SRIVASTAVA
description: On Saturday, Houthi rebels executed a large-scale offensive against Saudi Arabia, causing tremors in the capital, Riyadh, where explosions reverberated. Flight operations at the nearby airport faced delays as Saudi air defenses successfully intercepted a ballistic missile aimed at the city. The Houthis boasted of striking key strategic targets, including an Aramco facility, marking a pronounced escalation in the ongoing regional strife.
title: Watch: Smoke over Riyadh airport after Houthi's major attack on Saudi Arabia

description: A new iPhone launch usually means one thing: people checking their bank balances and then convincing themselves they need an upgrade. But this time, some Indian buyers have taken the calculation a step further- by boarding a flight to Dubai.

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Amid rising Houthi threats, Turkey extends military aid to Saudi Arabia, potentially putting the new Saudi-Turkey-Pakistan defense agreement to the test. This pact ensures collective defense among member nations under attack. However, Pakistan has confirmed that there are no immediate plans for military action. Additionally, Saudi Arabia is pursuing military support from the US to counter the Houthis’ aggression.

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Arjun Erigaisi bounced back from a difficult start to the Chess Olympiad with a convincing victory over Maksim Chigaev, helping defending champions India beat Spain 3-1 in Round 4. Gukesh continued his impressive run, while Praggnanandhaa and Nihal Sarin drew. India’s women also remained unbeaten, beating Mongolia 3-1 as both Indian teams maintained their winning momentum in Samarkand.

author: VINEET RAMAKRISHNAN
description: India begins its campaign at Aichi-Nagoya with a 500-plus athlete contingent; 314 of them are making their first Asian Games appearance. Mirabai Chanu returns with the Asian Games medal missing from her collection, while Anahat Singh arrives as a World Junior Squash Champion. Defending champions Avinash Sable, Tajinderpal Singh Toor, Parul Chaudhary, Jyothi Surekha Vennam and Satwik-Chirag will look to build on India’s 106-medal haul at Hangzhou.
title: Champions return, 314 debutants arrive: Inside India’s 500-plus Asian Games campaign

author: ABHAY
description: Police probing the murder of Adani Realty project manager Yuvraj Singh Manchanda are examining whether he knew about an alleged fraud racket involving his former colleague Anya Vats and her partner Sanyam Sachdeva. An FIR details how the duo allegedly duped a senior executive of over Rs 1.2 crore using fake government notices, while investigators examine their movements and electronic devices.
title: ‘Sell your wife’: Delhi's killer couple who murdered executive face fraud probe

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Rupert Murdoch’s former Aspen retreat has returned to the market for $29.85 million after a major renovation. Murdoch bought the 11,500-square-foot mansion for $3 million in the early 1980s and listed it for $5 million in 1995. The renovated property now spans 12,172 square feet across just over two acres.
title: Murdoch's Aspen mansion lists for $29.85M after $3m buy in 1980s

author: GITESH SHELKE
description: Siya Goyal and Chetan Chaudhary allegedly used a fake social media account to lure her fiancé Ketan Agarwal.  The trio studied a past case and films before planning the businessman's murder.  They identified Lohagad Fort as a suitable location for the fatal fall.  The plan was executed on June 18, leading to Ketan's death in a gorge.  Police filed a comprehensive chargesheet based on extensive digital and forensic evidence.
title: Fake Insta account, ‘Operation Honeymoon’: How Siya Goyal plotted fiancé's murder
